sources.entry: 16. Sightengine - AI-driven image and video analysis API.

summary.name: Sightengine
summary.one_liner: Sightengine is an API for content moderation and image/video/text analysis, detecting nudity, violence, hate, spam, AI-generated media and related risks.
use_cases: verify identity during onboarding or account recovery
detect AI-generated images, videos, voices or music
summary.what_it_does: Sightengine offers APIs to assess, filter and moderate images, videos and text, with 150 moderation classes covering nudity, hate, violence, drugs, weapons and self-harm. It also detects AI-generated images and video, synthetic speech and voice clones, and AI-generated music. Face liveness and recapture detection aim to confirm a real person is present and not a photo or screen. Additional features include near-duplicate detection, detection of contact information and links in content, and low-quality image detection. The page says the API returns results instantly, uses SDKs and documentation, and that no human moderator is involved and images are not shared with third parties.
notable: 150 moderation classes including nudity, hate, violence, drugs and weapons
AI image, video, voice and music detection without needing watermarks or metadata
Face liveness and recapture detection for identity checks
No human moderators involved; images not shared with third parties
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; users are directed to sign up or contact sales
Listed under 'Sites with API Integration' rather than as a standalone app
